caption: The drawing features a single wooden side table with two drawers. The table is rectangular with a flat top surface and stands on four turned legs that taper toward the bottom, each leg ending in a rounded foot. The table is shown in a front-facing perspective and appears to be made from a medium to dark brown wood, with grain patterns visible on the drawers and tabletop. Each drawer has two round, light-colored knobs. The shading and texture suggest the material is wood, and the entire table is neatly centered within a faint rectangular border drawn around it. There is a small printed signature "Edith M. Maguire" in the lower left corner of the bordering rectangle on the drawing. The background is a plain light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Two Drawer Stand
